Your quiz already runs. Now you'll give groups of statements names so you can see what each part does.

## Define and call a function

A **function** is a named group of instructions. `def` defines one; calling its name with parentheses runs it. A **parameter** is a name for an input to the function. An **argument** is the value supplied in a call.

Try this in `scratch.py`:

```python title="workshop/scratch.py"
def make_greeting(name):
    return "Hi, " + name + "!"

message = make_greeting("Alex")
print(message)
```

`name` is the parameter. `"Alex"` is the argument. `return` sends the finished string back to the caller and ends that function call. It does not print it. The output appears only when `print(message)` runs. A function without an explicit return value returns `None`.

## Organize the working quiz

Keep `questions.py` as it is. Replace the whole `quiz.py` file with this version:

<Code code={code} lang="python" title="workshop/quiz.py" />

`ask_question(question)` prints and validates one question, then returns the selected letter. `award_points(scores, clusters)` updates the dictionary it receives. Dictionaries are mutable, so the changes remain visible to `run_quiz()` without a return statement.

`run_quiz()` connects those jobs. Read its question loop aloud: ask, look up the selected choice, award its points. The work inside these functions is the same work you just ran in the previous milestone.

The last two lines use Python's entry-point check. When you run `quiz.py` directly, `__name__` is `"__main__"`, so it calls `run_quiz()`. If another file imports `quiz`, the definitions load without starting the interactive questions.

## Run and check

Run the file and answer `a` seven times. You should still get one point for every cluster. Moving code into functions should preserve the result.

Try changing the greeting inside `run_quiz()`. Names assigned inside a function are usually local to that function. [Make functions predictable](../../moving-forward/functions/) explains scope, `None`, and early returns with a small practice program.
